title: RM Turns 32, Tells Fans He's 'About to Start Writing Music Again'
detail: September 12, 2026 — BTS leader RM celebrated his 32nd birthday with a low-key gathering alongside bandmates, sharing Instagram photos of cake-cutting (including a Hello Kitty-themed cake) and a playful shot hugging a large Pikachu plush. Jin, Jungkook and V posted birthday messages that RM reposted; Jin's read simply 'Congratulations.' During an online birthday stream with fans the same day, RM said he is preparing to resume songwriting after the ARIRANG era: 'I'm just about to start writing music again, I don't know where to start. But I think it's about time,' adding he hopes to 'meet you all as many as I can, every continent, every places.'

media.caption: RM celebrates his 32nd birthday with BTS bandmates.

title: BTS Tops September Boy Group Brand Reputation Rankings Again
detail: September 12, 2026 — Soompi reported BTS held the No. 1 spot in the September boy group brand reputation index at 6,633,651 points, based on consumer participation, media coverage, interaction and community data collected Aug 12–Sept 12. Top-associated keywords included 'ARIRANG,' 'ARMY' and 'North American tour,' with related terms 'record,' 'sold out' and 'long run.' The group's positivity-negativity analysis scored 93.91% positive reactions. BTS separately topped the September advertisement-model brand reputation rankings at 3,932,230 points, up 10.70% from August.

media.caption: BTS leads the September 2026 boy group brand reputation rankings.

title: RM x SFMOMA Exhibition Details Confirmed Ahead of October Opening
detail: September 12, 2026 — Coverage detailed 'RM x SFMOMA: Between You and Me,' the first museum exhibition of RM's personal art collection, confirming it will pair roughly 200 works from RM's holdings and SFMOMA's collection — including Korean modernist and international artists alongside Western figures like Matisse, Rothko and O'Keeffe — running Oct 3, 2026–Feb 7, 2027 with member previews Oct 1–3. RM serves as lead curator and recorded a bilingual (English/Korean) audio guide and gallery playlist; it is billed as the exhibition's only U.S. presentation.

media.caption: Promotional art for 'RM x SFMOMA: Between You and Me,' opening October 3, 2026.
